answer: Chess club membership with rating history is the check: a rating tracked with one federation for years. A farm faking 515 aliases needs 515 separate rating histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The nectar test is the price tag: 515 fakes mean 515 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The onyx signal is visible to every grader, and the willow ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
